column2: David addresses the song to the Lord after rescue from all enemies and Saul; the specific Saul reference remains alongside the general group.
Lord, rock, fortress and deliverer for my sake retain the vocative and final personal dative without adding a missing love declaration from the Psalm parallel.
Future guarding and trust move from third-person God to direct Thou wilt save, retaining defender, horn, helper and refuge images.
column3: From injustice construes adikou substantivally; an unjust person is also possible and remains open. Existing display lines are preserved.

column2: Future calling and being saved retain the Lord as worthy of praise and the enemies as the source of danger.
Propose For before the death-crushings to retain hoti, preserving torrents of lawlessness, stunned reaction and the inherited two lines.
Death's birth pangs and harsh assaults retain two different images rather than substituting cords or snares from another source.
The future call, cry and hearing from the temple remain alongside the final cry-in-His-ears nominal clause; all four inherited lines remain.
Earth's shaking and heaven's foundations, not mountains, retain joint disturbance and tearing because the Lord is angry with them.
Past rising smoke, future devouring fire and past kindling coals retain the selected tense changes and three display lines.
Bent heavens, descent and thick darkness beneath feet remain without a supplied physical explanation.
Sitting on cherubim, flying and being seen on wind's wings retain the selected appeared verb rather than substituting another flying verb.
Darkness as concealment, tent as water-darkness and thickening in air-clouds remain in three lines.
column3: The object supplied as it in He made it thick is inferred; the compressed final verb/clause remains unresolved.

column2: Brightness before Him produces kindled fiery coals; no additional hail is inserted.
The Lord's heavenly thunder and the Most High giving His voice remain parallel before the continued action in verse 15.
Arrows scattering and lightning confusing them preserve paired weapons and effects; the second sent is elliptical, not a separate new agent.
Sea outlets and exposed inhabited-world foundations remain at the Lord's rebuke and breath of angry spirit.
column3: Outlets is a working rendering of apheseis; the water-opening image is not replaced with a settled channel geography.

column2: Propose He sent from on high rather than He reached from on high for apesteilen. Taking and drawing from many waters retain divine agency and both inherited lines.
column3: The object of sent is unexpressed; no hand, angel or other specific agent is inserted. The close elliptical English does not resolve that omission.

column2: Powerful enemies and haters stronger than the speaker retain plural opponents and the stated reason for rescue.
The enemies' confronting on distress day contrasts with the Lord becoming support, continuing into the spacious-place rescue.
A spacious place and rescue because of divine delight retain both action and reason in the inherited two lines.
Past repayment is repeated for righteousness and clean hands; it is not harmonized to the later future repayment.
Keeping the Lord's ways and not departing impiously from God explain the preceding claim of righteousness.
All judgments before the speaker and not departing from statutes retain both the positive orientation and negative action.
Future blamelessness and guarding beforehand against my lawlessness remain; the possessive is not changed to someone else's offence.
Future repayment according to righteousness and clean hands before His eyes remains distinct from verse 21's past.
Direct divine Thou and future show Thyself retain holy and complete parallels with the existing two lines.
column3: The Greek passive forms' relational force is rendered as self-manifestation, not a settled claim about God being made holy or complete by an outside agent.

column2: Chosen with chosen and crooked with crooked retain the future relational sequence and direct address.
column3: The difficult crooked reciprocity is not replaced by an explanatory doctrine of judgment; show Thyself remains provisional voice interpretation.

column2: Future salvation of poor people and humbling eyes upon the lofty retain direct divine address and contrasted objects.
Propose For Thou art my lamp to retain hoti; direct Lord address then third-person future lighting remain with both existing lines.
Propose For by Thee to retain hoti before the lightly armed runner and wall crossing; existing two lines remain.
column3: Monozonos literally concerns being singly girded and can denote light equipment; the exact equipment sense remains open, and a troop-breaking image is not imported.

column2: The Mighty One's blameless way, strong fire-refined word and defence of all trusting people retain the three existing lines.
Mighty apart from the Lord and future Creator apart from our God retain both questions.
column3: Creator follows ktistes; rock is not substituted to match a familiar parallel.

column2: Strengthening with power and shaking the way free, blameless, remain in the selected tense sequence.
column3: The shaking verb and adjective's precise relation are difficult; made my way perfect is not silently substituted as a settled reading.

column2: Deer-like feet and placement on heights retain the parallel actions; feet is supplied in the comparison for natural English.
Training hands for war and God's breaking a bronze bow with the speaker's arm remain.
column3: The aorist breaking participle and arm relation are not changed to my arms can bend a bow; instrumental with remains provisional for the in-phrase.

column2: Thou gavest and Thy heeding retain direct address, defence of salvation and the causal enlargement before the next unit's expansion phrase.
column3: Heeding renders hypakoe without a supplied object; obedience or responsiveness remains a lexical question, not an accepted divine-humility paraphrase.

column2: Making room continues the preceding result construction, with steps beneath and legs not shaken; no new explicit divine verb is imported.
Future pursuit and destruction, no returning before completion, preserve the speaker's martial agency and full scope.
Crushing, no rising and falling beneath feet remain future and emphatic without an added limitation of enemies.
Future divine strengthening for war and bending attackers below the speaker retain parallel direct-address clauses.
Divine giving of enemies' backs and divine killing remain in past direct address.
column3: Thou didst put them to death is not changed to a first-person killing claim from another version.

column2: Future cries and no helper shift to the Lord's past nonhearing; the added repeated they will cry makes the second elliptical appeal grammatical without flattening tense.
Grinding like earth-dust and crushing fine like street-mud retain two destructive comparisons and past speaker agency.
Future divine rescue and preservation as head of nations precede the past service of an unknown people; all three inherited lines remain.
Foreigners' lying and ear-hearing obedience remain; lying is not silently replaced with an unqualified sincere submission.
Future casting away and stumbling from enclosures remain rather than an alternative fading-and-trembling reading.
The living Lord, blessed Guard and future exaltation of the God guarding salvation remain distinct clauses.
The mighty Lord gives vengeance and disciplines peoples beneath the speaker; discipline is not reduced to a neutral relocation.
Third-person bringing out shifts to direct future lifting and rescue from the man of wrongs; all three lines and address changes remain.
Therefore, acknowledging among nations and singing to the divine name retain direct Thee/Thy and the existing sentence boundary.
Third-person great deliverances to His king and mercy to His anointed, David and descendants for ever, close the song.
column3: The third-person form is not harmonized to the preceding direct address; descendants is the inherited contextual rendering of seed.
